interface Reading {
  get [`value`](): number;
  set value(input);
}
const reading: Reading = { value: 3 };
reading.value = 4;
console.log(reading.value);

class Gauge {
  private current = 1;
  get [`value`](): number {
    return this.current;
  }
  set value(input) {
    this.current = Number(input.toFixed(1));
  }
}
const gauge = new Gauge();
gauge.value = 2.25;
console.log(gauge.value);

const key = `level`;
class Meter {
  private current = 0;
  get [key](): number {
    return this.current;
  }
  set level(input) {
    this.current = input * 2;
  }
}
const meter = new Meter();
meter.level = 5;
console.log(meter.level);

const literal: 'value' = key === `level` ? `value` : 'value';
interface Keyed {
  [`b`]: number;
}
const keyed: Keyed = { b: 7 };
console.log(literal, keyed.b, { [`a`]: 1 }.a);
